description: Defines the Currency class for formatting currency values with customizable symbols, spacing, locale, and decimal settings within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: A class for formatting currency values with customizable options such as symbol position, spacing, locale, and decimal places.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Currency object with specified formatting options, including currency code, decimals, separator, symbol position, spacing, and locale.

methods.name: setCurrencyCode
methods.description: Sets the currency symbol or code.

methods.name: setCurrencySymbolPosition
methods.description: Sets the position of the currency symbol (leading or trailing).

methods.name: setCurrencySymbolSpacing
methods.description: Sets whether there is spacing between the currency symbol and the value.

methods.name: getLocaleFormat
methods.description: Generates the locale-specific currency format string.

methods.name: formatCurrencyCode
methods.description: Returns the formatted currency code, considering locale if set.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns the formatted currency string based on current settings.
